summary: Evertec, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that Evertec Group, LLC and other loan parties entered a seventh amendment to the December 1, 2022 credit agreement with a lender syndicate and Truist Bank as administrative and collateral agent, effective November 5, 2026. The amendment fully refinances the existing Term A facility and revolving credit facility and adds $100 million of incremental revolving commitments, fungible with the replacement revolver. The $387.8 million refinancing Term A facility was incurred via a cashless roll; the Term A and revolving facilities mature November 5, 2031, with a springing maturity tied to $875 million of Term B loans maturing October 30, 2030. This is an ordinary credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for any 2026 refinancing-driven change in interest expense or covenant headroom rather than deal arbitrage.
